tenantSources.themanagement-db: published tenant-theme-canary-fixtures document resolved through the production compiler

referenceLab.captureLaw: capture each tenant in its own html-root iframe or single-tenant load; compare identical scene, viewport, locale and content
referenceLab.authorityLaw: this lab decides DS grammar and tenant divergence; product applications are later integration consumers and cannot certify or reject DS craft
referenceLab.modularizationOwner: R0 must split the existing monolithic torture route behind scene-owned import boundaries without duplicating trees fixtures or data

verticalScope.law: The DS and its reference lab are the only build and visual-certification target; deferred is a sequencing state, not a removal, and generic guarantees (fail-closed transport, exports contract) are preserved intact.

bithire.note: BitHire will be fully rebuilt; no screen of its current UI is a destination or visual reference, and no BitHire semantics enter the DS.

f4cCanary.scope: DS reference lab only; no cohort expansion before an accepted canary
f4cCanary.stopCondition: any unexpected diff in non-status channels or painted properties, any exact-restore failure, or any constitutional gate turning red rolls the canary back to HEAD state and opens a defect
f4cCanary.authorityLaw: the canary certifies the cascade effect in the lab; it is not programme closure and not a BitHire UI review

currentImpactTruth.purpose: Starting evidence deficit; not a quality score or target denominator.

invariants: one status authority
one static and DB normalization model
one semantic icon supplier
no tenant selectors or tenant conditional component trees
BitHire and The Management comply with the binding tenant art direction on the same tree
R1 visual evidence comes only from the hardcoded DS reference lab with zero product application CSS routes APIs or domain fixtures
advisor narratives are ephemeral non-canonical input; accepted findings are reproduced against source and incorporated into the owning contract
no public token creation by family writers
every productive CSS rule has one family or foundation-runtime owner
zero dead orphaned or causally disconnected CSS at accepted round scope, full Modern corpus closure in R5/R6 and complete replay after R7 customization changes
every tenant-variable CSS decision resolves directly or derivationally through the canonical static BrandTheme and DB TenantTheme chain
all creative proposals adjudicated within their round
tests do not award visual quality points
only the DT (Kimi K3) may accept sighted quality
new layer grammars stop after three calibration families and every cohort stops after at most twenty-five families for DT review
each round stops before the next owner-authorized round
local commits follow DT verification of the bounded packet
this program never pushes; publication requires an explicit owner-authorized release window

BitHire enters only as final consumer-readiness (install/pin, exports/imports, build, typecheck, smoke); no migration, adoption, hardcode-drain or canary lots over its current UI, and no BitHire semantics enter the DS
app-platform and app-evnto are DEFERRED: no migration lots open against them; deferred is a sequencing state, not a removal
dark mode carries no dedicated work in this stage; a lot touching shared surfaces must not degrade the authored dark baselines
governed channel precedence: explicit tenant value > authored vertical value > DS base; no compiler, gate or component branches on tenant or vertical name
instance overrides use the existing tiers (profileOverrides, RecipeProfileProvider, scoped attributes); no scope field is added to the tenant capability registry
accumulated local-ahead is owner policy, not a defect or a blocker; external local backup is recommended hygiene, never a gate

a cohort release gate (reliable instruments, accepted F4C canary, zero active brandable hardcodes in the adopted cohort, static+DB lab certification) authorizes early cohort exit; it is not programme closure
